language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: You can change it later in Settings.

protects.title: What Facto does not collect
protects.body: Facto does not ask for your name, phone number, email or location, and does not store your IP address. There is no account. Your posts, comments and votes are not linked to each other on our servers.

limits.title: What Facto cannot protect
limits.body: The content itself can identify you. A detail only a few people know can point to you. Facto also cannot protect a phone that is already compromised, and without Tor your mobile operator can see that you use Facto.

panic.title: Erase everything quickly
panic.body: Long-press the Facto logo to erase all data and keys on this phone. The app then starts again as if it was just installed.

empty.title: Nothing to read yet
empty.body: Cases from your area will appear here.

empty.title: Search runs on published cases only

mapEmpty.title: Map of areas
mapEmpty.body: Counts per area, never exact places. Areas with fewer than 5 cases show no count.

empty.title: Posting arrives in a later version
empty.body: You will choose a type, a category and an area from the list. Your location is never read.

empty.title: No alerts
empty.body: Urgent public-safety alerts and updates on your own cases will appear here. Facto does not send push notifications.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: Your cases, drafts and saved posts stay on this phone and are never synced.
